detail.longDescription: Everyone has a different way of managing projects. Some people like to use their inbox to keep track of tasks. Others prefer to visualize work on a Kanban board or in a calendar view, while some even prefer the old pen and paper system. That's fine on an individual level, but when you collaborate on projects as a team, you need a flexible and capable project management tool that works for everyone.
